mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role ( tenant_id, role_code, role_nm, use_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( (SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1), #{roleCode}, #{roleNm}, #{useAt}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_role SET role_nm = #{roleNm}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
UPDATE tb_role SET use_at = #{useAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.menu_code AS menuCode, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, COALESCE(m.menu_dc, '') AS menuDc, m.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, m.menu_order AS menuOrdr, m.menu_url AS menuUrl, COALESCE(m.icon_nm, 'Menu') AS iconNm, m.use_at AS useAt, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN p.permission_code = 'PERM_WRITE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'write' ELSE 'read' END AS permissionLevel, 1 AS accessible FROM tb_menu m INNER JOIN tb_role_menu_permission rmp ON m.menu_id = rmp.menu_id INNER JOIN tb_permission p ON rmp.permission_id = p.permission_id INNER JOIN tb_role r ON rmp.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN tb_tenant_subscription ts ON ts.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND ts.subscription_status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN tb_plan_menu pm ON pm.plan_id = ts.plan_id AND pm.menu_code = m.menu_code AND pm.use_at = 'Y' WHERE m.use_at = 'Y' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND r.role_code = #{value} GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_nm, m.menu_dc, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_order, m.menu_url, m.icon_nm, m.use_at ORDER BY m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_order, m.menu_id
